name: Maid de Oyuugi
source:
Near future. Main character gets to test the final version of a new maid-roid. He will need to test its abilities in competition with the rival company model.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
近未来，主人公获准测试一款新型女仆机器人的最终版本。他必须让它与竞争企业的机型较量，以检验各项能力。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-july-2001-cosmos-no-sora-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
